title: Telescope Feed

reward.description: A lens that only shows you one star at a time, but never runs out of stars.

hints: Any function containing `yield` is a generator. `yield x` hands out one value and pauses until the next one is asked for.
take(iterable, n): call it = iter(iterable) and then next(it) n times, stopping early if you hit StopIteration. Never call list() on the whole thing: it might be infinite!
For Orbit, write __iter__ as a generator method (with yield inside). Each call to __iter__ then starts a fresh, independent loop.
